metadata.question: Does the tropical rainfall rate increase in the western Pacific Ocean during 2009 compared to 1998?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need tropical rainfall data for Western Pacific Ocean - Two time periods: 1998 and 2009 - Western Pacific Ocean typically: ~120°E to 180°E, ~20°S to 20°N - Use TRMM (Tropical Rainfall Measuring Mission) or GPM for rainfall data - TRMM 3B43 V7 has monthly data from 1998-2015, perfect for this comparison 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for rainfall products (already processed) - Just need to calculate mean rainfall rates for both years 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If rainfall rate is 0 or very low (but valid number), proceed with comparison - C1: If no images found for either year - C2: If valid pixels = 0 after processing - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values - A: If 2009 rainfall > 1998 rainfall - B: If 2009 rainfall <= 1998 rainfall ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Western Pacific Ocean region (tropical belt) const westernPacific = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([120, -20, 180, 20]); // 2. Get TRMM rainfall data for both years const trmm1998 = ee.ImageCollection('TRMM/3B43V7') .filterDate('1998-01-01', '1998-12-31') .filterBounds(westernPacific); const trmm2009 = ee.ImageCollection('TRMM/3B43V7') .filterDate('2009-01-01', '2009-12-31') .filterBounds(westernPacific); // Check if collections are empty const size1998 = trmm1998.size().getInfo(); const size2009 = trmm2009.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1998 Images: ${size1998}`); console.log(`2009 Images: ${size2009}`); if (size1998 === 0 || size2009 === 0) { console.log('Missing data for one or both years.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Calculate mean rainfall for each year const mean1998 = trmm1998.mean().select('precipitation'); const mean2009 = trmm2009.mean().select('precipitation'); // 4. Calculate regional statistics const stats1998 = mean1998.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: westernPacific, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2009 = mean2009.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: westernPacific, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const rainfall1998 = stats1998.precipitation_mean; const rainfall2009 = stats2009.precipitation_mean; const count1998 = stats1998.precipitation_count; const count2009 = stats2009.precipitation_count; console.log(`1998 Rainfall: ${rainfall1998} mm/hr, Pixels: ${count1998}`); console.log(`2009 Rainfall: ${rainfall2009} mm/hr, Pixels: ${count2009}`); // 5. Validation and final answer if (count1998 === 0 || count2009 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels found.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (rainfall1998 === null || rainfall1998 === undefined || rainfall2009 === null || rainfall2009 === undefined || isNaN(rainfall1998) || isNaN(rainfall2009)) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check for unrealistic values (rainfall rate in mm/hr should be 0-50) if (rainfall1998 < 0 || rainfall1998 > 100 || rainfall2009 < 0 || rainfall2009 > 100) { console.log('Invalid rainfall values detected.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare rainfall rates const increase = rainfall2009 - rainfall1998; console.log(`Difference (2009 - 1998): ${increase.toFixed(4)} mm/hr`); if (rainfall2009 > rainfall1998) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
